description: geomayenne.fr: water datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geomayenne.fr. Coverage: the area served by geomayenne.fr. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about water; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Stations d'épuration en assainissement collectif du département de la ; Etude des sols sur la commune de Saint-Aubin-Fosse-Louvain en Mayenne; SDIS Défense Incendie - Château d'eau du département de la Mayenne; SDIS Défense Incendie - Hydrants du département de la Mayenne. Formats seen: WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
